KISWAHILI — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mjadala.
